name: RAMINO POKERATO
description: Ramino Pokerato is an Italian Rummy game that combines draw-and-discard melding with poker-style betting. Players receive 10 cards from a double deck with four Jokers; after an optional blind and betting round, play proceeds with draw from stock or discard, then discard, until a player goes out by melding 10 cards in sets and runs and discarding the 11th.

content.text: Ramino Pokerato is an Italian Rummy game that combines draw-and-discard melding with poker-style betting. Players receive 10 cards from a double deck with four Jokers; after an optional blind and betting round, play proceeds with draw from stock or discard, then discard, until a player goes out by melding 10 cards in sets and runs and discarding the 11th.

Ramino Pokerato is an Italian Rummy variant that combines Rummy melding with poker-style betting. The name means 'Pokerised Rummy' and applies to several Italian games; the version with Jokers and betting is described by John McLeod from Antonio de Sebastiano and others.
Three to five players (best); adaptable to more with extra packs.
Double deck of standard 52-card packs plus four Jokers (108 cards total).
Table and chips or agreed stakes.
Dealer shuffles and is cut by player to dealer's right. Each player receives 10 cards dealt one at a time. Remainder is stacked face down as stock.

items.text: Ramino Pokerato con Jolly immaginario: Played with double deck and no printed Jokers; when going out, one card in hand may be nominated as a wild card to complete one combination.
Ramino Pokerato carioca: Contract version: eight deals, each with a different opening meld requirement; 13 cards each; no poker-style betting; scoring by card values; winner of game takes game pool.
Ramino Pokerato con rilancio: Betting version with blind and raises (rilancio); same draw-discard and go-out rules as main game.
